message.content: {"summary":"Strong, well-referenced mission concept for Great Barrier Reef bleaching monitoring with clear users and need. Your Gantt-based plan is detailed but lacks contingencies and contains a major orbit error (600 km 'geostationary'). Preliminary progress is modest — tutorials and research only, with no technical results. Presentation is clear, but references are bare URLs rather than proper citations.","next_steps":["Correct the orbit description: geostationary orbits are ~35,786 km; a 600 km orbit is LEO and cannot remain fixed over the reef. Reconcile your orbit choice with the imaging resolution your reef-monitoring concept implies (likely a LEO constellation).","Add explicit contingency provisions to your project plan (e.g. buffer time, fallback tasks) and explain why the plan is structured this way in the context of the mission.","Present preliminary technical results from your STK work — e.g. orbit parameters, coverage or revisit-time outputs — with brief interpretation, not just a list of completed tutorials.","Replace bare-URL footnotes with proper in-text citations matched to a reference list, and add a caption for your Gantt chart figure.","Derive formal mission requirements (e.g. spatial resolution, revisit rate, latency) explicitly from the identified user needs."],"criteria":{"C1":"Your mission concept and rationale are clear and complete: GBR bleaching monitoring, explicit users (marine and conservation scientists), and strong need justification supported by cited literature (NOAA, Nature, NatGeo). To consolidate the Accomplished level, state formal mission requirements derived from user needs rather than leaving them implicit.","C2":"Your Gantt chart with weekly tasks, deadlines and stage-based descriptions is detailed and credible. However, there is no provision for contingencies or variations, and the plan contains a significant technical error — describing a 600 km orbit as geostationary — which weakens credibility. Fixing the orbit description and adding contingency planning would lift this to Accomplished.","C3":"You have completed four STK tutorials and useful literature research on bleaching detection, but no preliminary results, calculations, or orbit/coverage outputs are presented or interpreted. The Accomplished level requires a good preliminary set of results with brief description and interpretation, showing you are clearly on track.","C4":"Your report is well structured with clear headings, readable prose, and a labelled Gantt chart with legend. However, references are bare URLs as footnotes rather than proper citations, the report is very short (~2 pages), and Image 1 lacks a caption. Consistent, properly formatted citations and fuller development would reach Accomplished."}}
